DESCRIPTION:
Store the credentials of a Loopia account under a name

USAGE:
    loopia account create <NAME> [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    <NAME>    Name you will pass to --account, e.g. ivy

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                        Prints help information                   
        --username <USERNAME>         LoopiaAPI username, e.g. user@loopiaapi   
        --password <PASSWORD>         LoopiaAPI password; prompted for without  
                                      echo when omitted                         
        --customer-number <NUMBER>    Customer number, resellers only           
        --endpoint <URL>              XML-RPC endpoint, when it differs from the
                                      Loopia default                            
        --default                     Use this account when no --account is     
                                      given                                     
        --force                       Overwrite an account of the same name     
                                      without asking
